name: Cerdanyola del Vallès (Spain)
description: Green field with the first vertical third occupied by four red lozengy bars on a yellow ground outlined in white.
history: The flag was approved on 21 November 2005 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4534 of 21 December 2005; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, green, with the first vertical third occupied by four red bars of lozengy structure, not touching each other, on a yellow ground outlined in white.

features.role: four bars of lozenges which do not touch, on yellow outlined white
